ArubaGame._on_finish emits exactly one runtime result after a completed shift: earned, accumulated stress_delta, and BASE_SHIFT_HEALTH_DELTA plus accumulated health_delta.

runtime_result:aruba:convenience:10_interactions starts at BASE_PAY, processes exactly CONV_TOTAL=10 handled-or-timeout interactions, sums each handled bonus and stress or timeout stress, and emits fixed health -3 because convenience interactions do not change health.

runtime_result:aruba:delivery:selected_nonempty requires a nonempty route within DEL_TIME_BUDGET=120 and computes money=BASE_PAY+tips+delivery_count*DEL_BASE_BONUS+delivery_count*DEL_RAIN_SURGE_PER_ORDER, mental=-max(delivery_count-2,0), and health=-3-delivery_count-1 for the rain shift.

Bundle prerequisites consume named completed bundles, exact typed action receipts, applications, relationship stages, memories, and player initiative.

The action_receipt prerequisite helper requires the exact bundle, action, authored month, optional application identity, and one exact live weekly commitment authority; only the explicit Jiyeon legacy contract may fall back to a pre-schema completed bundle without minting a receipt.

A live typed action receipt is reconstructed only from one full-scan weekly commitment at the exact integral receipt turn; malformed, fractional, absent, or competing same-turn rows fail closed instead of inheriting reverse last-wins lookup semantics.

A matching Seoul action follow-up is unique and binds the exact bundle, action, and raw integral turn; fractional or duplicate nested owners cannot reconstruct the Seorin or Jiyeon typed action receipt.

Historical target reconstruction requires the same exact action identity and source month, and accepts a Jiyeon fallback only when its migrated schema-two identity agrees with the closed Month 2 completion authority.

A legacy origin is minted once only from the post-GameState-load schema-two boundary: the exact 040746 core projection, its exact empty or in-flight loaded pending commitment, and the exact producer-owned weekly rows at source turn 1 through 9. Completed direct actions own one row, generic scheduled Story bundles own none, and only the pacing-owned Week 4 temptation boss owns a Story row. This proof does not claim authority over malformed rows already discarded by the non-ORDER-101 deserializer.

The frozen 040746 witness has exactly eight identity and source fields, binds the exact schema-two core projection and producer-derived weekly census at one integral source turn from 1 through 9, preserves the exact loaded pending commitment, and revalidates its frozen Story flag authority on every lookup/reload. An in-flight action contributes a weekly row only after its result is ready; an in-flight generic Story contributes none, while the Week 4 pacing boss may contribute its owned Story row after choice.

A schema-three continuation has exactly one demo_core_loop_v2@040746a origin receipt and one witness copy; the two copies must be semantically identical and the shared witness must still pass the exact validator.

Normalization mints only on an exact schema-two source and otherwise only looks up an existing exact witness on schema three, then rebuilds the equal origin and plan-origin ledgers before deriving any Rain fallback; relabelling a current save cannot re-mint compatibility authority.

The 040746 origin reconstructs every relationship stage, legacy receipt key, and player-initiative entry from exact ordered history rows. Each row is bounded by the source turn, uses one frozen authored bundle/event/choice outcome, owns the exact source-plan slot, and is either exactly completed at that turn or is the exact active source-turn bundle; the raw stage, receipt, and initiative ledgers must then equal the reconstruction. Future, unscheduled, duplicate, malformed, or stage-divergent relationship authority cannot be injected before schema-two relationship migration.
The 040746 origin accepts only string-keyed, unique, bounded routine receipts whose exact two-unit producer shape matches the authored plan, and every completed turn owns its exact receipt.

The 040746 shown-consequence ledger follows the frozen immediate producer topology: opening_interview_math can be consumed only at Week 2 after the exact Week 1 Mirae application authority, and temptation_consequence only at Week 5 after the exact Week 4 boss authority. An active consequence is likewise confined to its exact Week 2 or Week 5 phase and must not already appear in the shown ledgers.

Legacy typed authority is consumed only after the raw schema is exactly integral schema two and the exact 040746 origin mint produced its named receipt. That admitted origin alone gates shown-consequence synthesis, schema-two relationship migration, action recovery, and prototype completion lift; exact schema three preserves current authority, while fractional, future, or otherwise unknown schemas clear legacy relationship ledgers and cannot enter those compatibility consumers.

Finalized action recovery accepts only an exact current-schema source or one admitted 040746 origin and preserves the raw integral active turn. The legacy branch resolves exactly one matching frozen action row; the current branch requires its exact live weekly owner and authored application identity. A witnessed legacy row serialized as current cannot re-mint a deleted receipt, fresh-W1 recovery must pass its committed-owner gate, and application state is validated before any recovered receipt becomes authoritative.

Fresh-W1 application recovery requires result_committed with no pending Week-1 commitment, exactly one capacity allocation, exact embedded-to-outer Seoul-cycle identity and details, and a nested action whose derived receipt equals the candidate. Failure removes the action receipt, Mirae status, transition receipt, and result-ready signal rather than promoting pre-result material.

An in-flight 040746 opening-interview or SNS Story derives its pre-choice versus exact chosen phase only from the frozen authored flag combinations. The same witness validator requires an already-shown opening to have exactly one truth/lie branch and an already-completed SNS owner to have exactly one authored q0/q1/q2 flag tuple. Missing seen flags, ambiguous outcome flags, and contradictory branches invalidate origin admission on every reload.

Only an admitted frozen origin may install active legacy Story authority. A pre-choice opening seeds only its old submitted application state; an exact post-choice opening or SNS source writes one canonical current Story receipt at the frozen bundle, event, choice, kind, and turn, with the opening application transition written atomically.
An admitted post-choice legacy opening or SNS owner is completion-ready only when its exact installed current Story receipt and, for opening, exact application transition/status are valid.

MainGame first presents any admitted pre-choice legacy roots, then completes an exact post-choice legacy owner: schedule owners advance the completed week, while consequence owners refresh and defer the week router so the next application/SNS notebook verb cannot stall.

The sole 040746 Week 4 temptation Story row binds choice zero to its clean reachable outcome and flags, or choice one to exact 2,000,000 money, bounded stress, and the crossed-line flag set. The frozen row, live branch flags, and later W8 clean/fallout root cannot disagree.

Every 040746 direct-action weekly row is bound to the exact scheduled bundle, historical action identity, family, empty person/forgone owners, and frozen per-action producer shape. In particular, the old Seorin application identity is exactly seorin/submitted rather than the current seorin_contract_2026q1 identity, while Rain must match one enumerated delivery tuple; current-ID swaps or impossible outcomes cannot mint typed action authority during migration or recovery.

Every loaded 040746 weekly row has the frozen producer shape for its scheduled bundle. Direct-action rows require the exact action family, action ID, echoed-turn sentinel, per-bundle details, and producer-reachable outcome; the sole Week 4 pacing Story row requires the exact owner/event/choice identity, complete forgone-choice complement, money axis, and delayed timing.

The 040746 weekly witness ledger is ordered exactly by producer turn: every completed direct action owns one row, generic scheduled Story bundles own none, and only the pacing-owned Week 4 temptation boss owns a Story row. An in-flight action owns its source-turn row only after result readiness, while a Week 4 in-flight boss may be before or after its durable choice row. Reordering, duplication, omission, or an invented generic Story row fails closed.

A durable 040746 Month 1 or Month 2 plan origin contains exactly schema, origin, month, planned turn, frozen availability, and the exact validated legacy plan; Month 2 freezes whether Hyunsu reachout was historically available.

A continued plan-origin entry must have the exact six-field shape, equal the live plan, retain the exact Month 2 availability witness, and revalidate that plan against a reference state reconstructed from the frozen availability.

A raw schema-two load derives equal plan receipt and witness copies from its exact origin core, while schema-three continuation accepts only equal exact-key plan-origin ledgers whose entries still match the live plans.
Legacy schedule consumers first require the exact generic origin, then read a Month 1 or Month 2 plan only from equal receipt and witness copies whose entry still validates against the live plan.

After commit_plan stores the exact legacy plan, it installs the durable plan-origin entry before exposing the state, allowing a witnessed old plan created after the initial origin mint to survive reload without reconstructing provenance from current metadata.

Normalization rebuilds the sole Jiyeon compatibility fallback from the exact 040746 witness only when Rain is completed exactly once at authored Week 6 or 7, occupies that exact source-plan slot, and owns one exact legacy weekly row; a schema-three continuation must also retain the exact live completion, fallback and migration receipt and no typed Rain action receipt.

A legacy Rain action must equal one producer-reachable nonempty subset of the frozen six delivery routes within 120 minutes: integral earnings equal 90000 plus route tips and 8000 per route, health request equals -3 minus route count, mental request equals minus max(route count minus 2, zero), money is exact, and omitted stat deltas represent only a clamped zero while explicit zero or impossible deltas fail closed.

Rain compatibility resolves exactly one loaded legacy weekly row at the exact completion turn, with the exact ten-field schema-two action shape, Rain bundle/family/action identity, empty person and forgone owners, and one exact delivery tuple admitted by the frozen producer enumerator.

The exact ORDER-101 terminal route slice binds M1 resume quality/expiry, all three father choices/expiry, M2 advancement expiry, both M2 people selections/expiry, and the M2 sleep action receipt to distinct playable targets.
Terminal routes are created only from an exact live source terminal plus their typed action, relationship, selected-trigger, or expiry provenance.

Historical month validation reuses a result only within the same outer validation context and exact month/cut-turn key after a collision-free Variant equality token binds the normalized state, turn, player, locale, flags, weekly ledger, raw core state, authored-data revision, and locale-content revision. Replacing either authored Dictionary reference or changing either monotonic revision clears the cache; every exact input mutation replaces the token and clears it, while a recursive in-progress key returns empty authority and is never evaluated or cached as provenance.
Supported in-place authored-data overrides advance DataRegistry.content_revision, and normal registry reload advances the same monotonic generation after rebuilding the authored dictionaries.

Refreshing localized content clears every cached UI table and advances LocaleManager.content_revision, while each newly loaded built-in or community table advances the same generation before historical localized projections may be reused.

Historical node replay first requires terminal-binding raw-field presence to equal one fully typed, nonempty binding shape. A genuinely non-terminal-bound node may retain an explicit empty resolved trigger only when its authored disable-without-trigger rule, locked zero-progress projection, stable owner/place/summary identity, threshold/deadline, and no-fallback fields are exact and its target-opening ordinary eligibility re-derives successfully to the exact empty set.

Historical replay treats an unselected terminal-bound node with an exact nonempty ordinary-candidate array as runtime-open for deadline expiry, while a genuinely initially locked node must own zero allocations and cannot be reinterpreted as expired.

Historical terminal resolutions require the exact same sorted bound-node identity set from full-shape binding fields in the raw summary, durable target witnesses, and receipt-derived expected bindings; a typed fabricated binding without both independent authorities is rejected.
The M1 resume terminal proof binds its exact action receipt, application transition, turn, capacity and quality without accepting a free resume_polished flag.
The M2 self terminal proof binds the exact sleep-debt action receipt bundle, rest action and source month before exposing the M3 recovery variant.
Target-month board candidates are derived only from validated durable terminal bindings and preserve the authored target node, bundle, variant and source identity.

_write_save_payload serializes the full payload to UTF-8 JSON bytes, writes and readback-verifies a temporary file, replaces the primary save, then verifies the final bytes as an expected save payload.

_read_save_candidate reads save bytes, parses a JSON Dictionary, extracts payload.state with legacy fallback, validates that state and its typed fields, and returns the exact payload and state Dictionaries.

load_game selects a verified save payload, takes its state Dictionary through narrative-rhythm migration, and passes the result to GameState.load_from_dict; this is the disk-read entry point for the implemented W1-W24 roundtrip.

The demo_collision completion gate derives whether the selected current Story choice requires an applicable application outcome receipt.
The city application outcome is applicable only when the frozen demo_collision context contains city_work_sample.

The completion helper selects exactly one applicable authored outcome whose exact current Story receipt identifies the chosen event/index, then requires one exact application transition key and payload joined to its application/from/to/bundle/event/choice/turn, the resulting application status, and a fail-closed raw-key/value census with no sibling authority.

Every current Story receipt consumer fail-closes on the full selected owner/event/turn identity census: malformed canonical-prefix keys, same-event wrong-owner keys, scalar values, off-key values, and duplicate siblings cannot coexist with the one exact canonical receipt.

Before a generic Story producer writes, the event-scope preflight scans canonical-prefix keys, same-event current-turn keys, and values claiming that event/turn so a second sequential choice cannot append beside an existing choice.

The generic Story producer revalidates the current schedule/consequence owner, current turn, and membership of the event in that live owner's authored roots before validating the choice; it rejects any competing event-scope receipt, accepts only the exact canonical callback as idempotent, and writes one canonical current-owner receipt.

note_story_choice snapshots the raw core-loop state before normalization and treats generic plus deferred, obligation, relationship, and application typed writers as one callback transaction; if any expected writer fails, it restores the exact pre-choice core-loop state instead of leaving partial receipts.

StoryMode asks the V2 transaction classifier before applying authored effects. A fresh unowned prologue choice remains an ordinary Story choice and mints no V2 receipt; the retired legacy Send and every exact-deferred Week-24 root always enter strict commit preflight even when their claimed transport or context is absent or malformed, while an authorized active-owner root snapshots the full serialized GameState and restores it after an unavailable/apply failure or rejected DemoCore callback so no partial authored or typed-receipt effect survives.

The transaction rollback first loads the saved snapshot, then deep-copies every Dictionary/Array field from that snapshot back onto GameState before emitting the state change signal; compatibility normalization cannot leak into a failed Story choice.

Current relationship/application outcome readers census the full raw key/value owner-event-turn union, fail closed on malformed, off-key, wrong-event, scalar, or duplicate authority, and require the one exact expected receipt.

The only allowed same-owner application transition sibling is the exact pre-plan Week-One opening Send receipt: canonical key and nine-field payload, not_submitted-to-submitted transition, legacy_story_send source, empty fresh onboarding state, interviewed final status, and all three producer flags.

demo_collision completion validates the exact context and current obligation, plus resolved dirty receipt iff dirty. When the selected choice requires the applicable city outcome, completion requires the exact choice-correlated Story and application transition authority; generic Story/Hyunsu morning receipts remain outside this gate.
